zones.label: Deck
zones.tooltip: Your draw deck. When you need a card and it is empty, your discard is shuffled into it.

zones.label: Face down
zones.tooltip: Your card for this round, face down. Only you may read it. It turns over when both players have played.

zones.label: Storm Cloud
zones.tooltip: Five cards to gain from. You may only take one at or below your *Tier*. After any card leaves, another is drawn to replace it.

zones.label: Deck
zones.tooltip: The *Spellstorm Deck*. When it runs out, the *VOID* is shuffled to become the new one.

zones.label: VOID
zones.tooltip: Cards removed from the game. When the *Spellstorm Deck* runs out, this becomes the new one.

zones.label: Weather
zones.tooltip: This round's weather. Only the current card is active.

zones.label: Calm
zones.tooltip: The eight Calm Before the Storm cards sit on top of the *Weather Deck*, so the first battles are gentle. When they run out the sixteen standard cards are shuffled in.

zones.label: Ice
zones.tooltip: Six *ICE*. Given to an opponent's discard, and returned here when *VOIDed*.

zones.label: Ash
zones.tooltip: Six *ASH*. Given to an opponent's discard, and returned here when *VOIDed*.

zones.label: Curse
zones.tooltip: Six *CURSE*. Given to an opponent's discard, and returned here when *VOIDed*.

zones.label: Dragons
zones.tooltip: *Tier IV*. Gained by filling your *Power Track* while already at *Tier III*.

cards.comment: The two moves are one discard, and the detour is the whole of "without triggering any discard effects". An On Discard fires on a card going from a hand to a discard; leaving a hand for the quiet is not that, and leaving the quiet for a discard is not either. SPELLSTORM. Win by reaching *8 Storm Shards*, or by taking your opponent to *0 health*.

A battle is four rounds. Each round: the weather is flipped and resolved, both players play a card face down, the cards are revealed, and they resolve in *Initiative* order. Countering the opponent -- *Fire* beats *Earth*, *Earth* beats *Water*, *Water* beats *Fire* -- draws you a card.

After four rounds comes the *Regroup*: discard effects fire, the cards you still hold are your *Blast Score*, the higher score takes *2 Storm Shards* (1 each on a tie), and each player gains one card from the *Storm Cloud* at or below their *Tier*.

Six *Power Tokens* fill your track; filling it raises your *Tier*. At *Tier III* a filled track gains you a Dragon instead.

cards.story: Eight *Storm Shards*. The storm answers to you now, and the crag is quiet for the first time in an age.
The Spellstorm takes what it is owed. Somewhere below the waves, something with too many teeth finishes the sentence you started.
